data.title: 太湖东山 · 制图综合三维原型
data.coordinateConvention: x=easting-originE; z=originN-northing; y=source height metres; terrain rows advance south (+z)
data.terrainType: DSM includes roofs and vegetation; not bare-earth DTM

focusBoundary.name: 东山镇
focusBoundary.role: display selection using OSM boundary, not authoritative cadastral/legal boundary

data.focusMaskPolicy: landMask is actual source-derived land/water classification. focusMask separately flags Dongshan display focus. Hide or fade land outside focusMask without changing it to water.

waterLevelHint.type: static visual reference from prevalent source DSM mapped-water pixel height; not current observed lake level

sources.terrain: Copernicus GLO30 AWS 2021 release; underlying tile acquisitions 2011–2014

attribution: Overture Maps Foundation; see source per-feature attribution and local data ledger

limitations: Roof groups and inferred heights are display symbols, not measured buildings.
Water/road network completeness and full topology are not certified.

Land cover and DSM reflect older source periods, not a 2026 ground survey.
